en: A simple religious greeting postcard with black text and a blue handwritten Bible verse on a cream background. In the upper left corner there is a black graphic of a Christian cross rising from an oil lamp with a small flame. The blue handwriting across the top contains a Finnish quotation from the New Testament (2 Corinthians 8:9). Below, in printed Finnish text, the card offers Christian wishes of comfort, grace, and peace to a sick friend at Christmas, invoking Jesus Christ. The sender is identified as the Oulu regional branch of the Christian Association of Finnish Nurses.
